newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cook wants UK to become leading Europe player.
newsitem.headline: Cook wants UK to become leading Europe player.

text.p: British Foreign Secretary Robin Cook, on his first trip abroad, said he wanted Britain to have a "fresh start" and to become one of the three leading players in Europe alongside France and Germany.

"I want to make sure that Britain has a fresh start in Europe and that Britain joins France and Germany as the leading players," Cook told reporters after meeting French Socialist opposition leader Lionel Jospin.
Cook said that Labour's landslide election win last week, ousting the Conservatives, would be good for Europe.
Cook said the Labour party had close ties with the French Socialists but it was willing to work with any government that emerged from France's snap May 25/June 1 parliamentary election.
Jospin and Cook declined comment on Britain's willingness to join a single European currency. Jospin said that Cook's visit was an "encouragement" in his election campaign.
